title: Redistricting isn't playing out how the GOP hoped. And, Brazil's Lula wins 4th term
description: Republicans are spending millions on the midterms, and they still may not win districts drawn to favor them. And, Brazil's Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva won a fourth term in a stunning political comeback.

title: Political consultant on the impact of Republicans' gerrymandering efforts
description: NPR's Leila Fadel speaks with political consultant Mike Madrid about how Republicans' gerrymandering efforts have backfired.

title: Trump escalates anti-Muslim attacks against El-Sayed in Michigan
description: President Trump intensified his anti-Muslim rhetoric against Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday, portraying him as a threat to national security and questioning his loyalty to the United States.

title: Republicans are spending millions and still may not win districts drawn to favor them
description: Republicans redrew Congressional district lines to try to tilt the midterms in their favor. But now they are facing expensive and competitive races they had hoped to outmaneuver.

title: Blanche defends DOJ lawsuit blocking Alaska Senate results if Republican loses
description: Attorney General Todd Blanche defended the Justice Department's suit over Alaska's Senate race in an interview on CNN.

title: Politics chat: The polls show a Democratic sweep in the midterms. Can you trust them?
description: If you look at the few truly competitive seats, polls show a more complicated picture of momentum toward the Democratic Party in midterm House races. For the Senate, Republicans are on defense.

title: Democrats see an opportunity to tilt Pennsylvania's state legislature their way
description: Statehouse elections this fall could swing the balance of power in state capitals. In Pennsylvania, Democrats could take control of what has been a divided legislature.

title: Independent candidates sense a moment. Some Democrats hope they're right.
description: As they look to win the Senate, Democrats are hoping that independent candidates in Nebraska and Montana can help them topple Republicans in a part of the country where their own brand is hurting.

title: In Arkansas, Democrats see an opening at the edge of the competitive midterms map
description: In a sign of the potentially dire midterm political environment, Republicans have spent millions of dollars playing defense in Arkansas, one of the most conservative states in the country.

title: The rise of the economic populist: What voters want from both parties this year
description: A new kind of economic populism is surging in both parties this year as voters search for a political party that can solve growing concerns about financial stability.
